feature.headline: Fresh law graduates can sit for Civil Judge exams until 31 March 2027
feature.text: In Bhumika Trust v. Union of India (21 Aug 2026), a three-judge bench of the Supreme Court, by a 2:1 majority, cut the practice rule for Civil Judge (Junior Division) from three years to one year, with a transition window for new graduates.
points: Until 31 March 2027, every law graduate is eligible to apply, with no practice needed.
From 1 April 2027, you will need one year of verified practice, certified by the High Court.
Selected candidates do one year of Judicial Academy training plus a one-year law clerkship (6 months with the District Judiciary, 6 months with a High Court judge).

sections.title: Judicial Services & Judiciary
sections.short: Civil Judge exams, High Court research posts
sections.intro: Judge-track openings and court research roles. Research and clerkship posts are the best first step for fresh graduates aiming at the bench.

items.name: Law Researcher / Research Associate
items.org: High Court of Jharkhand, Ranchi · Advt. No. 01/Recruitment Cell/2026
items.eligibility: Fresh law graduates and postgraduates; 5th-year (5-year LLB) and final-year (3-year LLB) students may apply if they pass before joining. Minimum 60% aggregate. Age 21–28.
items.note: Apply by email: one PDF of scanned documents, 10 MB max, sent to the address given in the notification.

items.name: Civil Judge (Junior Division): Odisha Judicial Service
items.eligibility: LLB; Odia language proficiency. Under the Supreme Court's August 2026 ruling, fresh graduates are now eligible during the transition period.

facts.v: Closing date extended until further notice

items.note: OPSC put the closing date and the 5 July prelims on hold after the Supreme Court's order in Bhumika Trust. New dates will be announced separately. Watch the OPSC site.

sections.title: Government Legal Jobs & Internships
sections.intro: Government roles open to students and new graduates. Most PSU legal jobs hire through CLAT PG scores, so the exam page matters here too.

items.name: Internship Programme, Oct–Dec 2026
items.org: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI), New Delhi
items.eligibility: Law students at bachelor's or master's level (among other disciplines). Minimum 2 months, maximum 6 months.
items.note: Earlier applicants must apply again. Shortlisted candidates may be asked for a write-up or presentation.

also.title: Also open, but they need practice experience

list.text: OPSC Assistant Public Prosecutor, 172 posts: 2 years' practice, closes 28 Sep 2026, prelims 22 Nov
Central Railway, Railway Advocates, 33 posts: 3 years' practice, closes 23 Oct 2026
NALSA Assistant (Legal) and Assistant Legal Aid Advisor: 1–3 years' experience, closes 10 Oct 2026

sections.title: Exams & Entrance Tests
sections.short: AIBE, UGC NET and other qualifying exams
sections.intro: Qualifying and eligibility exams. LLM entrance tests (CLAT PG, AILET) are on the LLM Admissions page.

items.name: All India Bar Examination XXII
items.eligibility: LLB graduates, and final-semester LLB students with no backlogs. You need this to practise law.

items.name: UGC NET, December 2026 (Law)
items.eligibility: For LLM students and graduates (a master's degree is required; final-year LLM students may apply). Leads to Assistant Professor posts and the JRF.
items.note: NTA has announced the exam dates. The registration notice is still awaited.

sections.title: LLM Admissions: NLUs & Maharashtra
sections.short: NLUs, state universities and private colleges in Maharashtra
sections.intro: Where you can apply for an LLM starting in 2027. NLU seats open now through CLAT PG and AILET; Maharashtra's state and private colleges usually open later, so they are tracked here until their official notices appear.

items.name: LLM at NLUs through CLAT 2027 (PG)
items.eligibility: LLB graduates; final-year students may apply. One CLAT PG score covers LLM seats at the consortium NLUs, including the three Maharashtra NLUs (Mumbai, Nagpur, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar). Many PSUs and the Army JAG entry also recruit on this score.
items.note: 120 MCQs, offline; 1 mark per correct answer, minus 0.25 for a wrong one.

items.name: LLM at NLU Delhi through AILET 2027
items.eligibility: Passed or in the final year of a 3-year or 5-year LLB.
items.note: 100 MCQs in two hours, offline. SC/ST and women candidates below the poverty line pay no fee.

items.name: LL.M. at University of Mumbai (LL.M. CET)
items.org: University of Mumbai, Department of Law and affiliated colleges
items.eligibility: LLB graduates; admission is through the university's own LL.M. CET.

facts.v: Applied till 15 May 2026, CET on 12 Jun 2026

items.note: Based on last year's timetable, expect the 2027–28 notice in spring 2027. Watch the university's admissions page.

items.name: LL.M. at Symbiosis Law School, Pune
items.eligibility: 3-year or 5-year LLB with 50% (45% SC/ST); final-year students may apply. Selection through Symbiosis AIAT (written test plus personal interaction).
items.note: SLS Pune says admissions for 2026–27 are closed. Last year's window opened in September, so check the official LLM page often.

items.name: LL.M. at NMIMS Kirit P. Mehta School of Law, Mumbai
items.eligibility: LLB with 50%; final-year students may apply. Admission through the NMIMS entrance test or a CLAT PG score, plus an interview.
items.note: The official portal still shows the 2026 cycle. Your CLAT PG 2027 score can be used here, so registering for CLAT keeps this option open.

sections.title: Private Jobs, Fellowships & Internships
sections.intro: Private jobs, fellowships and internships, taken only from the employer's own website. Big firms do not always post fresher roles publicly, so their official application portals are listed below.

items.name: Graduate Research Fellowship 2027
items.org: National Law School of India University, Bengaluru
items.eligibility: Open to scholars in law, policy and the social sciences. NLSIU does not state a minimum qualification, so read the call before applying.
items.note: On campus. Only candidates selected for interview are contacted.
